title: SAML 2.0 metadata privacy filter & trust-pinning assistant for secure connector onboarding
creator: Aisha Rahman
description:
Goal: Implement a safe, auditable SAML 2.0 setup flow that automatically sanitizes incoming IdP metadata for PII disclosure risk, supports trust-pinning (certificate fingerprint pinning with controlled rollover), integrates RBAC v2 approvals for connector creation, and writes comprehensive audit events for every metadata lifecycle action.

Background: Operators and security teams have raised concerns about sensitive fields in IdP metadata (contact emails, endpoints used for provisioning) being stored verbatim and visible to non-admins. We also need a better trust model for long-lived connectors: pinning to a certificate fingerprint mitigates silent MitM or metadata poisoning during automatic metadata refreshes, but we must make rotation and emergency rollback safe and discoverable. This ticket builds an assistant in the setup wizard that performs metadata ingest, shows a sanitized diff, enforces who can create connectors via RBAC v2, and emits audit-log entries for all changes.

Acceptance criteria (must be met for Done):
- Incoming metadata is parsed and a privacy-filtered view is generated that redacts contact fields, descriptive text, and any attributes marked as PII in our schema; the raw blob is encrypted at rest and only visible to users with the admin RBAC permission.
- UI: the setup assistant shows a side-by-side (raw vs sanitized) diff with toggles for "show raw (admin only)" and explicit consent checkbox when sensitive fields are present.
- Trust-pinning: system extracts certificate fingerprints for each signing/encryption key in metadata and displays suggested pins; connector creation must choose either (a) accept fingerprint(s) and enable automatic refresh with pin-check, (b) enable manual approval for fingerprint changes, or (c) a dry-run mode.
- Rollovers: provide workflow to add a secondary fingerprint (staged pin) and schedule cutover, with automatic fallback to previous pin if validation fails.
- RBAC v2 integration: only roles with connector.create or connector.admin can finalize connector creation; create flow must surface which role will be recorded as the approver.
- Audit logging: every ingest, sanitize, pin-change, approval, rollback and metadata-refresh event must write an audit entry with actor, timestamp, connector-id, change-type, and a signed integrity-hash of the raw metadata. Audit entries are queryable in Console and exportable to syslog/Splunk.
- Dry-run & validation: the assistant supports a dry-run validation that performs metadata signature checks, entityID uniqueness checks, endpoint reachability probes (optional, timeboxed), and a simulated login assertion to confirm attribute mapping.
- Security review: flags set so security_review_required is true and a review log entry exists before GA.
- Tests: parser unit tests, privacy-filter regression tests, RBAC unit tests, e2e provisioning test against a staging IdP, and an integration test covering pin rollover behavior.

Non-functional requirements:
- Latency for metadata ingest and sanitize must be < 1.5s for average metadata blobs (50–200KB).
- All raw metadata objects must be encrypted using KMS keys and carry an HMAC to detect tampering.
- Feature guarded behind feature-flag: saml_metadata_assistant_v2.

Implementation notes / approach:
- Extend existing metadata ingestion service with a privacy filter pipeline (normalize -> schema-annotate -> redact -> redact-audit-summary). Use a configurable allowlist/denylist for fields that are treated as PII.
- Add a TrustPin model that stores fingerprints with states: proposed, active, staged, revoked. Support lifecycle operations via API and surface in Console.
- RBAC checks: call RBAC v2 service at two points: (1) during draft creation to determine visibility of raw fields, (2) at finalization to ensure create/approve permission. Log decision outcomes in audit events.
- Audit schema: append audit records to the existing audit-log stream with additional metadata: raw-hash, sanitized-hash, pin-state, actor-role. Emit both structured JSON and a compact textual summary for older syslog parsers.
- Console: new wizard screen components: sanitized-diff, pin-picker, staged-rollover UI, and an "approvals" summary that shows pending RBAC actions. Provide links to the raw metadata (if permitted) and to the generated audit entry.
- Backwards compatibility: allow importing existing connectors; if raw metadata exists and lacks fingerprint, surface an advisory and require admin to add pin.

Rollout plan:
- Feature-flag behind saml_metadata_assistant_v2.
- Beta for internal SRE and 3 pilot customers in dedicated/private tiers.
- Monitor: metadata ingest error rate, pin-mismatch incidents, manual rollbacks, and audits-per-connector.

Open questions / trade-offs:
- Should we redact raw metadata before sending to analytics/telemetry? (Security prefers no; analytics prefers hashed-only copies.)
- How many staged pins do we allow? (Plan: two to support canary rollovers.)
- Whether endpoint reachability probes should be optional by default to avoid accidental outbound calls from private deployments.

Links to artifacts: design doc (Confluence), UX mockups (Figma), test plan, and a proposed GitHub PR for parser changes are attached below.
comments: 2025-01-21 — Kickoff: scoped with PM and Security. Decided to make privacy filter configurable and raw metadata encrypted by default. — Aisha R.
2025-01-28 — Prototype parser merged to feature branch; initial redaction rules for contact and org elements implemented. Manual review with security planned next week. — Tomas L.

2025-02-03 — Security flagged that some 'DiscoveryResponse' endpoints may leak internal hostnames; added rule to sanitize hostnames matching private ranges. Task split: ENG-58190 to add hostname sanitizer. — Aisha R.

2025-02-14 — Design review: Console mockups approved with accessibility notes; toggles for 'show raw' gated to admin role. UX follow-up: add confirmation modal for enabling auto-refresh with pins. — Evelyn Park (Design)

2025-02-20 — Integration tests: dry-run validation against staging IdP passed 12/14 cases; failures were due to chained redirects in the IdP metadata endpoints (timeout adjustments required). Test infra ticket created ENG-58612. — Tomas L.
2025-03-04 — Security review requested and scheduled. Preparing a proof-of-concept demo for pilot customers. Moving from In Progress -> hold for security signoff on 2025-03-10. — Aisha R.
